collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an elder and a child aged 6-12)

collection.description: Builders find a sealed jar of old childhood wishes, and an elder recognizes it: look for your own leaf, or start a new jar.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Under the floor of the old storehouse, the builders have found a clay jar, sealed with wax. Inside are leaves with little drawings scratched on them: a canoe, a big fish, a hut with a flower, a person with wings. (subject) recognizes it at once. When (subject.he/she) was a child, all the children put their wishes in a jar. (subject.He/she) had forgotten.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) suggests the children make a new jar. They draw their wishes on leaves \(a whale, a mountain of mangoes, a pet crab the size of a hut\) and seal them up. They bury it under a new corner of the storehouse. "When do we open it?" asks (friend). "When you've forgotten," says (subject).

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) goes through them carefully. One shows a stick figure sitting under a tree with a bowl of fruit. That one was (subject.his/her) wish. (subject.He/she) laughs: (subject.he/she) has spent a great deal of (subject.his/her) life sitting under trees with fruit. "Did your wish come true?" asks (friend). "Every afternoon," says (subject).
